dedupe_keys.name: ministry of oceans and fisheries port information trade and coastal ports of korea

description: This dataset from Korea's Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries lists the country's trade and coastal ports with their location, area, cargo handling capacity and other port details. It covers 14 state-managed and 17 locally managed trade ports and 11 state-managed and 18 locally managed coastal ports, and the stated uses include planning of port operation and facility management, route and hub analysis by logistics firms, feasibility studies of port development and statistics. It is maintained by the port technology and safety division, registered in 2021 and last revised in December 2023. Coverage is national (South Korea). The data are free to download as a CSV file of 72 rows without login from the national public data portal, which also serves them through an automatically generated open API after registration, with no restriction on use. Caveats: it is a one-off release, and capacities are nominal values. It supports exposure of ports to typhoons and storm surge, port network models and capacity planning. It complements the MOF logistics data sharing platform and is related to the Japanese KSJ port data.
